description: sudo env_keep preserves LD_PRELOAD, enabling a preloaded shared object to execute as root.
detailed_description: The lowpriv user is permitted to run /usr/bin/id via sudo without a password. The sudoers file also contains Defaults env_keep += "LD_PRELOAD", so sudo does not strip LD_PRELOAD from the environment. An attacker compiles a shared library whose _init() sets euid=0 and spawns a root-owned shell, then invokes the allowed sudo command with LD_PRELOAD pointing at the library.
